name: shadow-link
description: Shadow Link in a sidebar beside Claude Code: your likely reply drafted in your voice, why, and a side chat that knows the session.

min_confidence.title: Minimum ghost confidence
min_confidence.description: Ghosts scoring below this are not shown (0-1).

ghost_model.title: Ghost model
ghost_model.description: Claude model that drafts your likely reply in your voice after each turn (an alias such as haiku or sonnet). Set to off to show past replies only.

suggest_in_prompt.title: Ghost text in the chat bar
suggest_in_prompt.description: Show the ghost as dim text in the prompt box, Tab to take it.
